item.title: Giggleland
item.description:
Title: Giggleland
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie
Developer: Hooked
Publisher: Gamincat, Inc.
Release Date: Oct 26, 2026




About This Game

Booting up Assistant...
Loading Eliot...

O-oh! Hi there!

Heheh, it's been a while since I've met another kid! I'm Eliot, your Giggleland guide. Welcome to the place where smiles are forever!

This is Tolie. She doesn't talk, but she knows how to listen, and that makes her the best kind of friend. Her dad is waiting for her somewhere in the park, so first we're going to see Farmer Terry. He loves helping children find their way home!

There are only a few rules. Stay on the path. Stay where I can see you. And if a door says Staff Only, don't go in there. It's against the rules. You'll get in trouble!

Attention, guests. If you have seen a little girl wearing a white dress and a pink hat, please notify the nearest staff member immediately.

  • Explore all of Giggleland across eight chapters, from Farmer Terry's farm to the tunnels beneath the park.

  • About six hours of first-person psychological horror, in one complete game.

  • Uncover a story of family, belonging and the true cost of endless happiness, told by a fully voice-acted cast.

  • Giggleland does things no other horror game has done, and some of them happen outside the game. The full game is safe to stream * .

    * Giggleland is safe to stream and record, no streamer mode needed. Just capture the game window instead of your whole screen.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 or higher 64bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz or AMD equivalent
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 450 or higher with 1GB Memory
    • Storage: 25 GB available space

item.title: ShredDead
item.description:
Title: ShredDead
Genre: Casual , Indie , Strategy
Developer: Weird Penguin Games
Publisher: Weird Penguin Games
Release Date: Oct 26, 2026




About This Game

The world as you know it is over.

The dreaded zombie apocalypse has arrived.

You are ready to make your last stand and go down in a blaze of glory…

PROBLEM IS, you’re too good at this asymmetric warfare thing, and this “last stand” is taking forever. At this point, this is not about survival — this is about FUN . Shoot them, burn them, blow them up, and, if all else fails, SHRED THE DEAD — with your very own heavy-duty industrial shredder, of course.

ZOMBIE BLENDER

Get into a flow state of methodically decimating the unending deluge of zombies — or have your grunts do it for you! Or both!

BRANCHING OUT

As you turn more and more zombies into mincemeat, explore the vast skill tree to optimize the killing!

LOCK AND LOAD

Kit your grunts out with the best toys you can get your hands on — after all, zombies are nice enough to deliver the loot right to your doorstep!

EMBRACE THE YUCK

Zombies are known to evolve, but evolution is boring and takes too long. Why not have your mad scientist speed it up a little? With predictably gross results, of course!

item.title: CRACK
item.description:
Title: CRACK
Genre: Adventure , Simulation
Developer: Rafoli
Publisher: Rafoli
Release Date: Oct 26, 2026




About This Game

CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends work together to uncover what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

There is an egg.

It is very big.

Your job is simple: crack it open. Don’t ask why.

Who built this laboratory?

Why are you here?

Unlock hidden rooms and upgrade your tools throughout the facility.

The Egg reacts to you.

Listen closely.

Find out what's inside. Whatever happens after that is above your pay grade.

I’m building CRACK in public from Day 1! Follow the development on social media, and tell me what to develop next.

item.title: The Mailroom
item.description:
Title: The Mailroom
Genre: Indie , Simulation
Developer: Crowfriend
Publisher: Vendetta
Release Date: Oct 26, 2026




About This Game

Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Take the elevator down to the depths of hell, clock in, and get to work.

Time passes strangely in the dark realm, but you still punch a clock like any other job. Each day holds a different set of challenges to face and sinister developments to endure.

Use clues to properly identify and sort mail sent to your dark overlords. Fall into an all too familiar but satisfying routine. Don’t get too comfy though! Small slip-ups will not go unnoticed. The devil is in the details, after all.

Dissect (or pet) adorable amphibians, and process raw materials in order to provide the higher rungs of hell with vital umbral resources. Get the mixtures just right, and you may have a shot at employee of the month!

Keep the mail (and the blood) flowing with magical artifacts, and ancient tools. Despite residing in the dark domain, you should still keep a tidy workspace. Let the equipment fall into disarray at your own peril. If the mail stops, your heart might just be next.

Uncover the secrets of your surroundings and find your way to hell’s exit before you’re trapped for eternity.

  • Fire and brimstone aesthetic

  • Crunchy 3D art style

  • Mail sorting and pattern recognition

  • Time passage with punch cards

  • Potion crafting

  • Mystery solving

  • Dark humor

  • Resource management
